Loss report: gitlab -> gitea
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/po-x job.if (condition not expressible in GitHub Actions; job disabled)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/po ext.passthrough: inline child jobs (the child pipeline ci/push.yml runs inline as jobs po-created, po-x; the job po-created fails when the workflow rules of the child pipeline do not create it, as GitLab fails the trigger job, and every job that needs the call waits for it; a variable that a run sets by hand reads as unset in the child conditions, as GitLab does not forward it without forward:pipeline_variables, but its value reaches the scripts of the child jobs, because they run in the same pipeline; a return to GitLab restores the call and the child file only with the round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/po-created job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/po-created step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/po-x job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/po-x step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/po-created/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/po-x/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
